profile.name: paper-a5-single-gpu
profile.provenance: local interpretation of paper Tables A.4/A.5
profile.optimizer: Adam for every trainable network parameter; no Muon
profile.schedule: cosine to 0.03 times initial by collection step 250000; then constant
profile.schedule_unit: zero-based simulator collection step, before its learner updates
limitations: Does not supply the missing paper dataset filters or surviving-clip manifest
Does not implement multi-GPU gradient synchronization
Does not implement full training-state resume
Motion training only; velocity encoder architecture not aligned here
Uses the released simulator, normalization and return-sampler implementation
